Title: AKU graduates over eighty fellows, residents and interns
NewsSummary: The annual graduation ceremony for Fellows, Residents and Interns of The Aga Khan University's (AKU) Postgraduate Medical Education Programme will be held on Saturday, October 23, 1999. The President, College of Physicians and Surgeons, Pakistan.
NewsContent:
The annual graduation ceremony for Fellows, Residents and Interns of The Aga Khan University's (AKU) Postgraduate Medical Education Programme will be held on Saturday, October 23, 1999. The President, College of Physicians and Surgeons, Pakistan, Professor M. Sultan Farooqui, will be the chief guest. 

This year, 44 interns will be receiving certificates and 43 residents will be awarded certificates for sub-specialty training in several clinical disciplines. These include Adult Cardiology, Anesthesia, Community Medicine, Diagnostic Radiology, Family Medicine, General Surgery, Internal Medicine, Neurology, Obstetrics and Gynecology, Orthopedic Surgery, Pathology and Pediatrics.

AKU offers clinical training after M.B.B.S. in 22 specialties, which are recognized by the College of Physicians and Surgeons, Pakistan. In addition, programmes in General Surgery, Obstetrics and Gynecology, Orthopedics, Internal Medicine, Pediatrics and Family Medicine are also recognized by the concerned Royal Colleges in the UK.

Since 1990, 418 interns and 201 residents have graduated from AKU's postgraduate programmes. Approximately 70 percent of these physicians and specialists trained at AKU are currently working in Pakistan. Fifty-seven graduates are now on the full time faculty of the University and others are teaching in highly recognized medical institutions throughout the country.
